Claim amendment (this seat's claim 6554218344; the contract review 6554878186 FAILed PR #28587 at `2be3fd45`). ⛔ The branch, worktree, seat and model are unchanged.

File surface (widened in this act): in addition to the claimed files,
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`: the collection-registration loop. A connector item, and any collection item, registered under `ownerId` must not keep a body-carried `_packageId` that differs from `ownerId`. The fix either overwrites it or refuses it the way `permissionSetOwnerRegistrationRefusal` refuses a permission set (review must-fix M1).
- `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` (`source ?? options?.source`) or `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`: whichever is the narrower place to make an install-local install register every `packages[]` member as `'marketplace'`, whatever the entry states (must-fix M2).
- Their tests.
- Changesets for `@objectstack/objectql` / `@objectstack/cloud-connection` if touched.

`packages/spec/**` stays out of this claim (stop and report). Open PR #28554 (another seat) edits `cloud-connection` and `metadata-protocol`: ordinary concurrency, and the later lander merges `origin/main`.

Should-fixes carried into the same round: S1 (no bare "a stamp no row answers is the host's" default; host only for the residual owner the artifact names, or for no stamp) and S3 (the classifier's docblock says what it trusts). S2 is filed separately (stored or authored connector rows). S4 is already #28591.
